name: 3D Gaussian Splatting to Point Cloud
aliases: Gaussian Splatting to Dense Point Clouds
definition: Converts a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a dense point cloud that imitates the original scene, with optional mesh generation and color rendering.
summary: This method converts 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes into dense point clouds by sampling from Gaussian distributions, prioritizing high-fidelity geometry over explicit surface optimization.
